description: Fetch one template version: its JSON Schema, its default render options, an example payload and its HTML source. Read the schema before rendering — it is the contract for the `data` argument. Free.

include_source.description: Include the HTML source in the response. Default true. Set false when you only need the schema.

template.description: Template to use: `invoice` for the latest version, or `invoice@3` to pin version 3. Pin the version in anything you ship — a new version changes the output and the cache key. Call list_templates to see what this account has.

name: get_template
title: Get a template
